intro: Rêve bed creates a gentle nook where little imaginations settle and drift into dreamland. With calming tones and soft edges, it brings comfort, safety, and functionality into growing spaces.

features.title: Gentle shape and calming tones for cosy comfort
features.text: The Reve bed’s soft contours and warm Sonoma oak tones create a snug, reassuring environment. The enclosed design on two sides adds a sense of security, making bedtime feel calm and inviting.

features.title: Curved edges for safety
features.text: Rounded, filleted edges of this bed reduce sharp corners and enhance child safety. Plus, the softened silhouette makes the bed feel cloud-like and welcoming.

features.title: Underbed storage for practical organisation
features.text: The bed’s integrated box storage beneath the mattress panel provides generous space for toys, linens, or seasonal items. This hidden storage keeps the room tidy while maximising floor area.

features.title: Flexible LH and RH configuration
features.text: The longer side panel of Reve can be oriented to the left or right during assembly. This flexibility allows the bed to adapt easily to different room layouts.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
